_comment: Weather engine. Every week one continental weather condition is rolled from the month's weights (months: 1-12);
with `persistence` chance last week's condition simply continues if it can occur this month.
movement     land movement points per week (rail travel included: sidings flood and points freeze too)
armor_fuel   fuel burned by ARMOR formations while moving (the Rasputitsa: tracks churn in bottomless mud)
supply       weekly supply delivery to formations in the field
air          air power (sorties that can fly); 0 grounds every wing
freezing     true = frostbite: formations without a Cold-Weather Kit for (nearly) every man lose
frost_attrition of their strength and frost_morale morale each week (x winter_quarters when they
hold position inside their supply net), and fight at combat x firepower. Kitted formations fight at
Storms: each week, with storm_chance[season], a storm sweeps the seas: warships not in port lose
storm.attrition of their strength (ships founder) and storm.morale morale, and move at storm.sea_movement.

heat.name: Summer Heat
heat.description: Dust, heat exhaustion and overheated engines.

mud.name: Rasputitsa — Mud Season
mud.description: Roads dissolve into bottomless mud. Infantry wade, trucks sink, tanks churn through twice their fuel.

snow.name: Snow & Hard Frost
snow.description: Deep snow and killing frost. Men without winter kit freeze at their posts.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.description: White-out. Aircraft grounded, columns lost in the drifts, frostbite everywhere.
